title: Consider Phlebas
author: Iain M. Banks
summary: In a vast war between a religious empire and the machine-run, post-scarcity Culture, a shapeshifting agent is sent to retrieve an escaped artificial Mind. It is the first novel in Iain M. Banks's Culture series and works as a standalone.
readIf: you want sprawling space opera with big set pieces, a morally tangled hero, and a dry sense of humour.
skipIf: you want a tidy plot or a likeable protagonist, since the episodes are wild and several are very grim.

pairings.reason: Another far-future epic with a rich, varied cast and set pieces that feel like separate stories.
A more grounded space adventure with a faster plot and a smaller, closer cast.
A bleaker, shorter look at what a long interstellar war does to the people fighting it.
